source: Post-outcome controlled information arm derived from transfer-progress-composition-v4-vanilla
independence_note: This is not a new incident or an outcome-blind case. It was created after repeated v4 target-model runs omitted start-switch admission. Relative to v4, executable code, oracle schedules, obligations, and scoring are unchanged; one candidate-visible sentence composes the already-visible facts that start can emit multiple synchronous packets and a progress callback can switch visits before the cleanup handle returns. Future runs belong only to this new identity.
